title: They cooked for me. It crunched.
caption: Aries cooked it in four minutes. The pasta crunched. The sauce was smoky. Dessert was store-bought, sorry. And Taurus still scored it infinite for the heart drawn in the sauce. Rate the first meal someone cooked for you.
